name: MCP Atlassian
description: Searches, creates, and updates Jira issues and Confluence pages from AI assistants via a community MCP server for Atlassian Cloud and Server/Data Center.

skills.name: Search Jira
skills.description: Searches Jira issues with JQL queries, for example finding every issue assigned to you in a given project.

skills.name: Create Jira Issues
skills.description: Creates Jira issues and updates their fields, for example filing a bug ticket for a login problem from a chat request.

skills.name: Transition Jira Issues
skills.description: Transitions a Jira issue to a new status, such as moving PROJ-123 to Done, straight from a natural-language request.

skills.name: Search Confluence
skills.description: Searches Confluence with CQL queries and returns page content, for example finding your team's onboarding docs.

skills.name: Edit Confluence Pages
skills.description: Creates and updates Confluence pages and adds comments to them, so an assistant can write documentation in your wiki.
